title: Ladakh Tour Package
overview: Embark on the ultimate Trans-Himalayan odyssey: cross Khardung La (17,982 ft), ride double-humped camels through the cold desert dunes of Nubra Valley, gaze upon the shifting blue hues of Pangong Tso, and find tranquility in ancient Buddhist gompas with emergency oxygen backup throughout.
highlights: 1 Night in Luxury Swiss Camp at Pangong Tso (14,270 ft)
1 Night in Organic Farm Cottages at Nubra Valley + 3 Nights in Leh
Drive across world’s legendary Khardung La and Chang La passes
Bactrian Camel Safari in Hunder Sand Dunes & Diskit Giant Buddha
Inner Line Permits and portable medical oxygen cylinder in vehicle
inclusions: 5 Nights accommodation in 3★/4★ boutique hotels & luxury heated camps
Daily Breakfast & Dinner at all hotels and camps
Dedicated private Non-AC Innova / Scorpio with seasoned mountain driver
All Protected Area Inner Line Permits and wildlife environmental fees
Emergency Oxygen Cylinder and first-aid medical kit in vehicle
exclusions: Camel ride charges at Hunder and monument entrance fees
Personal snacks, hot drinks outside meals, and tipping

itinerary.title: Leh Arrival & Mandatory Acclimatization
itinerary.description: Land at Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport, Leh (11,562 ft). Transfer to your hotel. Strict complete rest for the entire day to acclimatize to high altitude. Evening gentle walk to Leh Main Market.
itinerary.morningActivity: Airport pickup and warm reception with traditional Khatak
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Complete rest and hydration in hotel room
itinerary.eveningActivity: Gentle stroll in Leh Market & Shanti Stupa sunset viewpoint
itinerary.stay: The Grand Dragon / Spic N Span 4★, Leh

itinerary.title: Sham Valley: Magnetic Hill, Sangam & Hall of Fame
itinerary.description: Excursion along the Indus River: experience the optical illusion at Magnetic Hill, witness the confluence (Sangam) of turquoise Indus and muddy Zanskar rivers, and visit the Hall of Fame war museum.
itinerary.morningActivity: Drive to Magnetic Hill and Gurudwara Pathar Sahib
itinerary.eveningActivity: Visit Hall of Fame and local Ladakhi tea cafe
itinerary.stay: The Grand Dragon / Spic N Span 4★, Leh

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La Pass (17,982 ft)
itinerary.description: Scale one of the highest motorable passes on earth — Khardung La. Descend into the picturesque Nubra Valley. Visit the 106-ft Maitreya Buddha at Diskit Monastery and ride double-humped camels in Hunder Dunes.
itinerary.morningActivity: Epic drive over snow-draped Khardung La Pass
itinerary.eveningActivity: Double-humped Bactrian camel safari in Hunder Sand Dunes
itinerary.stay: Organic Apple Orchard Resort / Luxury Swiss Camp 4★, Nubra

itinerary.title: Nubra Valley to Pangong Tso via Shyok River Route
itinerary.description: Drive along the rugged, scenic Shyok River gorge directly to Pangong Tso. Arrive at the high-altitude lake as its waters transition between turquoise, royal blue, and indigo. Stargaze under zero light pollution.
itinerary.morningActivity: Scenic off-road drive along Shyok River canyon
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Arrive at Pangong Lake (14,270 ft) & photography session
itinerary.eveningActivity: Witness dramatic sunset over the lake & stargazing
itinerary.stay: Deluxe Swiss Cottage Camp with attached heated bath, Pangong

itinerary.title: Pangong Sunrise & Return to Leh via Chang La Pass
itinerary.description: Witness an unforgettable sunrise reflecting off Pangong Lake. Journey back to Leh crossing Chang La Pass (17,590 ft). Visit the majestic 12-storey Thiksey Monastery on the return.
itinerary.morningActivity: Golden hour sunrise walk along Pangong shoreline
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Cross Chang La pass and visit Thiksey Monastery & Shey Palace
itinerary.eveningActivity: Farewell dinner and souvenir shopping in Leh
itinerary.stay: The Grand Dragon / Spic N Span 4★, Leh

itinerary.title: Leh Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Early morning transfer to Leh Airport for your scenic flight over the snow-capped Himalayan ranges.
itinerary.morningActivity: Transfer to Leh Airport with cherished memories
